**bscan_worst.png**: The lowest-scoring held-out scan by mean Dice over the fluid types its expert outline contains, shown on its B-scan with the most expert-outlined fluid. The model marked no fluid on this B-scan, which was chosen as the slice with the most expert-marked fluid, so it shows a complete miss on that slice. Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.

**bscan_median.png**: The median held-out scan by mean Dice over the fluid types its expert outline contains, shown on its B-scan with the most expert-outlined fluid. The model does not outline the fluid cavities that are clearly marked in the expert's outline. Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.

**bscan_best.png**: The highest-scoring held-out scan (whole-scan IRF Dice 0.83), shown on its slice with the most expert-marked fluid. The model's IRF outlines are close to the expert's but about a quarter smaller overall, and it marks a small SRF region the expert did not. Whole-scan figures from the final evaluation record (`docs/08` §5k). Left, the expert's outline; right, the model's. Chosen by the rule pre-registered in `docs/07` §21, from the numbers alone, before any image was rendered.
